AOK Wallet is the wallet for iOS and Android. It is an HD wallet: one set of recovery words restores every address.

## Create or restore

On the first start, create a new wallet or restore one from its recovery words. Then pick a password that unlocks the app on this phone.

> [!WARNING]
> The password only locks the app. Only the recovery words bring the wallet back on another phone.

## Send and receive

- **Send** takes an address, a user name or a payment link.
- **Receive** shows your address as a QR code.
- **Address book** keeps the addresses you send to often.

The send confirmation shows the whole receiving address. Compare it before you send.
